summary: Build the Reconnaissance primitive: a per-player, per-province boolean (ProvinceState.Reconnaissance), HasReconnaissance/GrantReconnaissance, and an enemy-province targeting shape keyed by index rather than a card id. Once granted it persists until the province's card is replaced (Refill) or the province is destroyed (DestroyProvince). Training fixture (training-scout) exercises granting and a Reconnaissance-gated Battle effect ahead of any real card needing it, matching the Token/Attack primitive-first discipline. Shared-file change: docs/ROADMAP.md is the cross-lane living checklist by design; all code changes are rules-lane engine-only, no client files touched.
